phrases.latin: Tum dēmum pater fīliō respondit: «Jam aderō.»
phrases.english: Only then did Dad answer his son: “Coming.”
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

phrases.latin: «Mātūrā,» inquit pater. «Raeda mox aderit.» «Jam aderō, tata!»
phrases.english: “Hurry up,” said Dad. “The taxi will be here soon.” “Coming, Dad!”
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: Lewis & Short: adsum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 101, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
